subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Spear Phishing: The Targeted Strike
description: Learn Spear Phishing: The Targeted Strike in one minute.

hook.text: A phishing email that uses your name, your boss's name, and a project you're working on.

buildup.text: Spear phishing targets specific individuals using personal details gathered from LinkedIn or company sites.

discovery.text: Because the email seems personally relevant, victims are far more likely to click.

twist.text: The information attackers need is usually public — posted by the victims themselves.

climax.text: Spear phishing is behind most major corporate breaches. It's precise, personal, and devastating.

punchline.text: The more you share online, the easier you are to target.

quiz.question: What makes spear phishing different from regular phishing?
options: It uses phone calls instead of email
It targets specific individuals with personal details
